### TermsModule {#TermsModule}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag">interface</span> <code class="sdk-qual">terms.TermsModule</code></div>

The terms module bound to a client context.

```ts sdk-signature
interface TermsModule {
  hasAccepted: (address?: string) => Promise<boolean>;
  accept: (input?: { ifNotAccepted?: boolean }) => Promise<{
    signed: boolean;
  }>;
}
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>hasAccepted</code> | <span class="sdk-type">(address?: string) =&gt; Promise&lt;boolean&gt;</span> | Whether `address` (default: the wallet account) has accepted the latest Obol terms and conditions. Neither an address nor a wallet: WALLET_REQUIRED. |
| <code>accept</code> | <span class="sdk-type">(input?: { ifNotAccepted?: boolean }) =&gt; Promise&lt;{ signed: boolean }&gt;</span> | Signs the terms and conditions (EIP-712, no chain id) with the wallet and posts the acceptance. `ifNotAccepted: true` signs only when the account has not accepted yet (`{ signed: false }` otherwise). Needed once per address before [`cluster.create`](../cluster.md#create) or [`cluster.accept`](../cluster.md#accept). |

</div>
